info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Tracks-v5-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Tracking API enables users to retrieve up-to-date information on shipment tracking. This API provides detailed insights into the status and location of logistics shipments, making it essential for businesses that rely on timely deliveries and effective supply chain management. Typical consumers include logistics managers, customer service teams, and systems aiming to provide shipment visibility to end-users. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their operational transparency and improve customer communication.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain real-time tracking details for their shipments, including current status, location, and estimated delivery times.

requestBody.description: Request body for tracking shipments. It contains the necessary parameters to retrieve the status and location of the specified shipment.

200.description: The tracking information was retrieved successfully.

ListLogisticsShipmentsTracksRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on shipments tracking. It is expected to be a string that may contain relevant tracking information.

ListLogisticsShipmentsTracksResponse_200.title: Shipment Tracking Response

status.description: Indicates whether the tracking operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: The identifier of the tracking result.

state.description: The current state of the shipment.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the tracking request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the tracking result.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit of the shipment tracking request.

ListLogisticsShipmentsTracksResponse_200.description: Represents the response structure for tracking shipments.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp of when the record was created in ISO 8601 format.

automated.description: Indicates whether the record was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Contains information about who created the record and when it was created.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A value of 0 indicates that the request was processed almost instantaneously.
